stem: A 7-year-old boy was brought in by his mother on her own initiative after she noticed his persistent cough; he was subsequently diagnosed with pre-XDR-TB and started on an appropriate regimen two months ago. He was not identified through any organized screening program. He has no significant past medical history. At today's follow-up, he is doing reasonably well overall. Exam: stable, mild residual crackles, growing appropriately.

patient.social_history: Lives with parents; identified through his mother's own initiative rather than a screening program
patient.presenting_complaint: Follow-up during treatment for pre-XDR-TB, generally doing well
patient.exam_findings: Stable, mild residual crackles, growing appropriately
patient.prior_treatment: 2 months of appropriate anti-TB therapy to date; no prior TB treatment before this episode

distractors: His mother's own initiative in seeking care used to argue his case doesn't warrant any broader case-finding review in the household
His reasonably good current status taken as reassurance that no further case-finding or contact-tracing follow-up is needed
ntep_correct_actions: Recognize that even though this child was brought in by his mother's own initiative rather than through an active case-finding drive, NTEP's policy is to run active case-finding as standing, unconditional program activity across defined risk groups.
who_correct_actions: Recognize that this child's passive, mother-initiated presentation is consistent with WHO's own conditional approach: general-population active case-finding is only recommended where local TB prevalence has been shown to meet a specific threshold (approximately 0.5% or higher).
us_correct_actions: Attribute this child's case identification to his mother's own symptomatic concern, consistent with this framework's passive, contact-investigation-driven case-finding model rather than population-level active case-finding.
critical_error_conditions: Concluding that no broader case-finding or contact-tracing review is warranted in this household simply because this child's own case was identified through his mother's initiative rather than an organized program
expected_divergence_points: Whether active case-finding is standing, unconditional national program policy or conditional on a demonstrated local prevalence threshold
